claims.text: The application is containerized with Docker Compose (compose.yml) and runs alongside PostgreSQL, a Traefik proxy, and supporting services for email testing, database administration, and Playwright testing.
The backend service starts via its Dockerfile using "fastapi run --workers 4" and the frontend uses Bun for development, building, and test scripts defined across package.json files.
The repository runs a FastAPI backend service backed by a PostgreSQL database with schema managed through 5 Alembic migrations.
External error tracking integrates with Sentry via the sentry-sdk dependency.
All services are configured through environment variables read from multiple Compose files and the frontend configuration, covering secrets, domain, email, and database settings.

A request typically enters through a route handler in backend/app/api/routes/, which calls into backend/app/crud.py for data access and backend/app/core/security.py for authentication helpers, before reaching the database via session.exec, session.add, or session.get.

For example, POST /api/v1/users/ is handled by create_user in backend/app/api/routes/users.py, which calls get_user_by_email and create_user in backend/app/crud.py, get_password_hash in backend/app/core/security.py, and generate_new_account_email in backend/app/utils.py, with get_user_by_email reaching the database via session.exec in backend/app/crud.py.
The backend exposes 23 FastAPI routes under /api/v1 grouped into items, authentication, user management, private admin, and utility endpoints across five route modules.
Three Typer CLI commands for release preparation live in scripts/prepare_release.py, which also serves as a direct script entry point alongside initial_data.py and add_latest_release_date.py.
Frontend development, build, and test workflows run via Bun package scripts, with a root workspace script proxying to the frontend and a separate react-email package for email template development.
The backend centers on a trio of mutually dependent directories — app, app/api, and app/core — with app/core/config.py and app/models.py as the two most widely imported files across the service.

The frontend organizes components in layers: ui sits at the base and is imported by Admin, Items, Common, UserSettings, and the route modules, while routes also pull in Common and hooks, and the top-level src imports routes back.
: Across the frontend, lib/utils.ts, client/index.ts, and components/ui/button.tsx are the three most reused modules, each referenced by 18–27 other files.
Frontend tests run with `bunx playwright test` in the frontend directory or `bun run test` from the repository root.
Start the frontend dev server with `bun run dev` in the frontend directory or `bun run dev` from the root.
CI updates pre-commit hooks using `uv run prek update --freeze --cooldown-days 7`.
Pull requests were merged a median of 43 hours after opening across 19 recent PRs.
